purpose: Separable atmosphere plate for the Signal to Dock social motion concept

Eight abstract signal traces converge smoothly toward an intentionally empty central docking zone, then fade into a clean dark field with a soft teal radial halo. Matte, minimal, calm, high-end Windows software identity, locked camera, generous negative space, no scene cuts. Keep the center clear for later exact vector-logo compositing. No typography, no words, no logo, no octopus creature, no jellyfish, no face or eyes, no organic tentacles, no mascot, no camera shake, no lens flare, no rainbow, no purple, no chromatic aberration, no liquid warping, no glossy 3D emblem.

deterministic_composite.policy: The generated plate remains background-only; the exact V2 stacked lockup receives uniform scale and alpha fade only.
